checks.label: I can state the purpose of this piece.
My main idea responds to the task or purpose I chose.
Each section contributes to that idea.
The opening gives my reader a clear starting point.
The order of ideas or events is deliberate.
Transitions show the relationship between sections.
My details are specific and relevant.
I can identify where borrowed material came from.
I checked exact quotations against the original source, where used.
I explain why my details matter, rather than only listing them.
I connect an example or moment to the larger idea.
My reasoning or reflection develops beyond a summary.
My voice suits my purpose and intended reader.
I replaced vague wording where precision matters.
Sentence choices help the reader follow my meaning.
I checked sentence boundaries and punctuation.
I checked names, spelling and formatting.
I read the piece again for errors after revising.
